title: Circuit Depth Compression via Spectral Gap Amplification in Quantum Phase Estimation
summary: We show that quantum phase estimation (QPE) circuits can be significantly compressed in depth by preprocessing the input operator with a sigmoid spectral filter before estimation. For systems with small spectral gaps Delta_lambda, standard QPE requires m = ceil(log2(1/Delta_lambda)) precision qubits and depth Theta(2^m). Applying a soft-step transformation f(lambda; tau,w) amplifies the effective gap to Delta_f > Delta_lambda (for w Delta_lambda log(1/epsilon). Validation on LiH and BeH2 bond-stretch calculations, classical covariance datasets, and synthetic near-degenerate cases…
